question: Who won the women's singles Wimbledon in 2018?

evidence.text: Jul 14, 2018 ... Ashleigh Barty has won the 2018 Wimbledon women's singles bracket, beating Serena Williams in the final. By James Brady@jamesbradyisme Updated ...
Jul 14, 2018 ... WIMBLEDON, England — Before Saturday, Serena Williams had addressed the crowd after contesting a Grand Slam final 29 times in her career ...
Ashleigh Barty defeated Serena Williams in the final, 6–3, 6–3 to win the ladies' singles tennis title at the 2018 Wimbledon Championships.
